# Architectural Decision Records (ADRs)

Humans propose, discuss, and approve decisions. Agents consume Accepted ADRs;
they do not own approval. See `.agents/skills/dough-adr-awareness/SKILL.md`.

| ADR | Status | Title |
|-----|--------|-------|
| [0001](./0001-session-state.md) | Accepted | Keep session state in Redis |
| [0002](./0002-package-sessions.md) | Proposed | Package session storage separately |
